identity.mail.confirm-email.customer.sub: Confirm your email for your MondaPac customer account
identity.mail.confirm-email.customer.bod: Open the link below and enter your password to confirm your email and sign in. The link works for {duration} and only once.
identity.mail.confirm-email.seller.subje: Confirm your email for your MondaPac seller account
identity.mail.confirm-email.seller.body: Open the link below and enter your password to confirm your email and sign in to your seller account. The link works for {duration} and only once.
You already have a MondaPac customer account
Someone tried to create a MondaPac customer account with this email. You already have one, so nothing was changed. If you forgot your password, you can reset it on the sign-in page.
identity.mail.existing-account.seller.su: You already have a MondaPac seller account
identity.mail.existing-account.seller.bo: Someone tried to create a MondaPac seller account with this email. You already have one, so nothing was changed. If you forgot your password, you can reset it on the sign-in page.
identity.mail.welcome.seller.subject: Welcome to MondaPac: your seller account
identity.mail.welcome.seller.heading: Welcome to MondaPac
identity.mail.welcome.seller.body: Your email is confirmed and your seller account is set up. We're reviewing your application and will email you when there's a decision. Until then you can sign in to see its status.
identity.mail.welcome.seller.body.no-app: Your email is confirmed and your seller account is ready. Sign in to go to your seller panel.
identity.mail.reset-password.customer.su: Reset the password for your MondaPac customer account
identity.mail.reset-password.customer.bo: Open the link below to choose a new password. The link works for {duration} and only once. Choosing a new password signs you out everywhere.
identity.mail.reset-password.seller.subj: Reset the password for your MondaPac seller account
identity.mail.reset-password.seller.head: Reset your password
identity.mail.reset-password.seller.body: Open the link below to choose a new password for your seller account. The link works for {duration} and only once. Choosing a new password signs you out everywhere.
The password for your MondaPac customer account was changed
The password for your customer account was changed on {time}. Your other open sessions have been signed out.
identity.mail.password-changed.seller.su: The password for your MondaPac seller account was changed
identity.mail.password-changed.seller.bo: The password for your seller account was changed on {time}. Your other open sessions have been signed out.
identity.mail.reviewer-notice.admin.subj: A seller application is waiting for review
identity.mail.reviewer-notice.admin.head: A seller application is waiting for review
identity.mail.reviewer-notice.admin.body: A seller has submitted an application for review. Open the review queue to see the applications waiting for a decision.
identity.mail.reset-password.admin.subje: Reset the password for your MondaPac admin account
identity.mail.reset-password.admin.body: Open the link below to choose a new password for your admin account. The link works for {duration} and only once. Choosing a new password signs you out everywhere. You will still need your authenticator app to sign in.
identity.mail.password-changed.admin.sub: The password for your MondaPac admin account was changed
identity.mail.password-changed.admin.bod: The password for your admin account was changed on {time}. Your other open sessions have been signed out.
Set up two-step sign-in for your MondaPac admin account
Your admin account needs an authenticator app before you can sign in. Open the link below, enter your password and add the account to your app. The link works for {duration} and only once.
identity.mail.invitation.admin.subject: You are invited to administer MondaPac
identity.mail.invitation.admin.heading: Your admin invitation
identity.mail.invitation.admin.body: You have been invited to create a MondaPac admin account. Open the link below to choose your name and password and set up your authenticator app. The invitation works for {duration} and only once.
identity.mail.second-factor-changed.admi: Two-step sign-in changed on your MondaPac admin account
Your admin account was moved to a new authenticator app on {time}. Your other open sessions have been signed out.
Two-step sign-in was reset for your admin account on {time}. Every session has been signed out. The next time you sign in you will be asked to set up an authenticator app again.
Too many wrong codes were entered for your admin account. On {time} two-step sign-in was locked for a while; it unlocks by itself.
identity.mail.invitation.seller.subject: You are invited to sell on MondaPac
identity.mail.invitation.seller.heading: Your seller account invitation
identity.mail.invitation.seller.body: MondaPac has created a seller account for you. Open the link below to choose your password. The invitation works for {duration} and only once.
identity.mail.seller-approved.seller.sub: Your MondaPac seller account is approved
identity.mail.seller-approved.seller.bod: MondaPac has approved your seller account. Sign in to go to your seller panel.
identity.mail.seller-rejected.seller.sub: Your MondaPac seller application needs changes
identity.mail.seller-rejected.seller.bod: We've reviewed your seller application and it needs changes before it can be approved. Sign in to see the status of your application, or contact MondaPac support if you have questions. The reason from MondaPac: {reason}
identity.mail.seller-suspended.seller.su: Your MondaPac seller account is suspended
identity.mail.seller-suspended.seller.bo: MondaPac has suspended your seller account. While it is suspended, no one on your team can sign in to the seller panel. If you have questions, contact MondaPac support. The reason from MondaPac: {reason}
identity.mail.seller-reinstated.seller.s: Your MondaPac seller account is active again
identity.mail.seller-reinstated.seller.h: Your seller account is active again
identity.mail.seller-reinstated.seller.b: MondaPac has lifted the suspension of your seller account. You and your team can sign in to the seller panel again.
identity.mail.common.account-line.custom: This email is about your customer account. A seller account with the same email is separate.
identity.mail.common.account-line.seller: This email is about your seller account. A customer account with the same email is separate.
identity.mail.common.account-line.admin: This email is about your MondaPac admin account.
identity.mail.common.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
identity.mail.common.not-you: If this wasn't you, reset your password from the sign-in page straight away.
identity.mail.common.footer: This is an automatic message from MondaPac. Replies are not read.
